name: inspect_plist
description: Requires an open binary or bundle-resource session; use open_binary or open_bundle_resources first. Parse its Info.plist by default, or select a local plist with path within that session. Supplying path does not open a session. Returns normalized JSON rather than plutil text. native_command_timeout_ms is each file or plutil command's wall clock (omitted means 60000 ms). The 67108864-byte plist input and decode allowances and the 998-level nesting allowance have no runtime override. XML sources also require native plutil validation, which can refuse shallower inputs with its own diagnostics. The 4096-byte markup probe is a probe window, not a document cap, and has no runtime override.
